desc:
What are you guys' favorite ***~ First Meeting ~*** headcanon for these two anyway? Do they know each other since they were little? Or right off the bat danmaku rivals? For one, it kinda seems like they already knew each other in *SoEW?*

And I remember reading this one fucked up doujin where they're actually sisters and I think Yukari made Marisa blonde and kept her as a spare in case Reimu died (which she did in the doujin, but officially it was "Marisa" while Yukari restored Marisa's true brown hair and have her be "Reimu").
